description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter class FavoriteAdapter for displaying a list of favorite recipes in an Android app, managing the presentation and interactions of individual recipe items.

classes.name: FavoriteAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView ListAdapter for FavoriteRecipe items, handling item differences and click interactions.

classes.name: FavoriteAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for the FavoriteAdapter, holding references to UI components of each item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a ViewHolder for a new item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a FavoriteRecipe item to the ViewHolder's UI components.
